pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the opencode-sidebar VS Code extension: what it does, how it fits together, and pointers to child pages for deeper reading.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation, configuration settings (binaryPath, serverUrl, serverArgs, defaultModel), activation events, and the VS Code command palette commands exposed by the extension.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Bird's-eye view of the three-layer architecture: VS Code Extension Host, Webview UI, and the opencode backend server. Describes how the layers communicate and links to detailed child pages.

pages.title: Extension Host
pages.purpose: Overview of the Node.js/VS Code extension host layer: activation, provider management, server lifecycle, and the bridge to the webview. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: Extension Activation and Commands
pages.purpose: Details the activate/deactivate lifecycle, command registration (newSession, restartServer, openSettings, focusSidebar, manageProviderKeys), and the provider key management UI flow using VS Code QuickPick.

pages.title: SidebarProvider and Server Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Covers SidebarProvider (WebviewViewProvider implementation), server detection via pgrep/ss/lsof, Spawn vs Attach modes, CSP/nonce security, and the restartServer/dispose lifecycle.

pages.title: Message Bridge and Bridge Protocol
pages.purpose: Explains the MessageBridge class that routes EventFromWebview actions to API calls and posts EventToWebview responses back. Covers the full discriminated-union protocol: ready, send, stop, switchSession, permissionReply, etc.

pages.title: OpenCode Backend Client
pages.purpose: Overview of the src/opencode/ layer that wraps the @opencode-ai/sdk and manages the server process and real-time event stream. Links to child pages for each component.

pages.title: API Client
pages.purpose: Deep dive into createApiClient, ApiClientOptions, the unwrap error helper, adaptFetch for Electron/Node compatibility, and all ApiClient methods: listSessions, createSession, sendPrompt, abort, replyPermission, listProviders.

pages.title: Server Process Management
pages.purpose: Covers startOpencodeServer, ServerHandle, ServerOptions, the URL_RE stdout-parsing pattern for dynamic port discovery, and graceful SIGTERM/SIGKILL shutdown via disposeChild.

pages.title: SSE Client and Event Streaming
pages.purpose: Explains connectEventStream, exponential-backoff reconnection, openSdkEventStream adapter for the SDK's AsyncGenerator, and the full Event union type re-exported from types.ts.

pages.title: Webview UI
pages.purpose: Overview of the browser-side webview application: bootstrapping, component tree, state management, and styling. Links to child pages for each major area.

pages.title: State Management
pages.purpose: Covers the Store class, State interface, initialState, and the reduce/reduceSse pure functions. Details session maps, partsByMessage, contextTokens, pendingPermission, status transitions, and modelNotifications.

pages.title: UI Components
pages.purpose: Overview of the component tree mounted by main.ts (Header, SessionList, MessageList, Composer) and how each component subscribes to the Store and posts EventFromWebview messages.

pages.title: Session List Component
pages.purpose: Details mountSessionList: collapsible session panel, session-row rendering, active highlighting, inline rename via dblclick, delete button, formatRel timestamp helper, and auto-collapse on session switch.

pages.title: Message List Component
pages.purpose: Details mountMessageList: rendering user vs assistant messages, role labels, model-change notices, scroll-pinning, thinking indicator, sessionRetry display, session error banner, and delegation to TextPart/ToolPart/PermissionPart.

pages.title: Composer Component
pages.purpose: Details mountComposer: textarea auto-resize, Enter-to-send, Send/Stop button toggling based on streaming status, model picker integration, and how prompts are dispatched via the post function.

pages.title: Model Picker Component
pages.purpose: Covers mountModelPicker, groupModels utility, provider ordering via PROVIDER_LABELS/KNOWN_ORDER, context-bar fill percentage, LSP label, search filtering, event delegation for model selection, and cleanup lifecycle.

pages.title: Markdown Rendering and Syntax Highlighting
pages.purpose: Explains renderMarkdownInto (marked + GFM), the Shiki highlighter initialization, language list, dark/light theme detection, code-copy button injection, and graceful degradation when Shiki is unavailable.

pages.title: Tool and Permission Parts
pages.purpose: Covers mountToolPart (status symbols, duration display, argsSummary), mountPermissionPart (Allow/Allow once/Deny buttons, keyboard shortcuts, renderMeta for command/diff/pattern metadata), and the PermissionDecision flow.

pages.title: Build, Tooling, and Development
pages.purpose: Overview of the build pipeline, test infrastructure, and developer tooling. Links to child pages for build configuration and testing.

pages.title: Build Pipeline
pages.purpose: Details esbuild.js dual-bundle setup (extension CJS for Node18, webview ESM for browser/es2022), watch mode with watchPlugin, production minification, source maps, and the dist/ output layout.

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Covers the three-tier test strategy: vitest+jsdom unit tests (scripts/test-unit.sh, .nvmrc), @vscode/test-electron integration tests (.vscode-test.mjs), and ESLint linting. Describes test patterns used across state, apiClient, bridge, serverProcess, and component tests.

pages.title: Design Documents and Roadmap
pages.purpose: Overview of the planning and specification documents in docs/. Links to child pages covering the diff panel plan and model picker design.

pages.title: Diff Panel Plan
pages.purpose: Documents the planned bottom-panel webview for reviewing LLM-proposed code changes as per-hunk diff blocks with Accept/Reject/Edit buttons, DiffParser, DiffApplier, and the data flow from SSE events through WorkspaceEdit.

pages.title: Model Picker Design
pages.purpose: Documents the design specification and implementation plan for the model picker feature: provider grouping, context window visualization, LSP status, and the search/filter interaction model.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, and domain concepts for onboarding engineers, each with code pointers.
